text: A retail investor asset threshold would be gamed: managers would be incentivized to keep retail assets under the applicable threshold, thereby keeping the fund in the existing regulatory scheme without implementing additional retail investor protection.
citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability (2009). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1428387
